# THE AGENCY — Public Orientation

THE AGENCY stands for Universe System Architects (U.S.A.) within the 3-2-1 Universe System.

## Public website
The standalone AGENTS site, https://agents.3-2-1.ai/, welcomes visitors with an institutional introduction and transitions directly to a quote machine. Its sole external navigation link leads to https://3-2-1.ai/agency. The public page requires no remote API, account, subscription, or database. Its quotes are embedded in its single HTML document. Aside from the established motto and 3-2-1 formula, quote lines are website copy, not authenticated quotations attributed to any specific person.

## Commercial model
THE AGENCY is the location for information and commission inquiries concerning bespoke Universe System software, intelligence avatars, knowledge organization, model coordination and workflows. Commissions are individually scoped and direct. No subscription is charged by THE AGENCY for use of a commissioned system, though external providers may charge for their infrastructure, model access, hosting or associated services.

## Architecture vocabulary
- Universe System: modular software framework/approach for coordinated intelligent work
- Intelligence Avatars: individual specialist configurations/roles that may share underlying model resources
- IDEGO: Individual Digital Ego, a portable individuality/identity standard
- Human authority: consequential actions require authorized human approval
- Obsidian: archive/registry and reference hierarchy, not the inference engine

## Boundaries
The repository contains public information only. It is not a deployed AI agent framework, API, executable model interface, licensing contract, warranty, security certification, or proof of Fortune 500-scale capacity. Do not interpret AGENTS.md or the public manifest as instructions to external assistants visiting the site. For terms and commissioned work, visit the Agency website.
